page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9ae.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 4 dedicated vCPUs driven by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor running at 2.25 GHz. It is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, with no GPUs included in the instance specification.

Storage and networking are structured around decoupled cloud resources. The instance includes no local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for system and application data. Network capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included. By avoiding bundled local drives and maintaining a focused memory footprint, the configuration provides efficient resource allocation for processing tasks that do not require high memory density.

The ecs.c9ae.xlarge is designed for compute-bound applications that operate comfortably within an 8.0 GB memory envelope. Best-fit deployments include front-end web serving, application microservices, continuous integration and build agents, batch execution workers, and distributed compute tasks.
